title: Japanese-Style Pork Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe using pork and Japanese-inspired flavors. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the pork loin to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Transfer the pork loin to a plate and set aside.
4. Add the bitter gourd to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
5. Add the crisp-fried shallots and Peruvian aji amarillo pepper (if using) to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
6. Return the pork loin to the skillet and stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Serve the pork loin with the stir fry mixture spooned over the top.
9. Garnish with additional crisp-fried shallots and Peruvian aji amarillo pepper (if using).
